name: Shared shell and design language

items.title: Reserve space below the setup banner
items.detail: Docker and Notes headings touch the banner; use one shared content offset and consistent top spacing on every route.

items.title: Turn the permanent setup strip into a setup notice
items.detail: Offer a direct setup destination, explain the affected feature, and allow dismissal after acknowledgement. Preserve the underlying setup requirement.

items.title: Align page gutters and headers
items.detail: Standardize title, subtitle, action row and content start. Current left gutters vary substantially between DNS, VMs, Support, Logs and Docker.

items.title: Use one primary button treatment
items.detail: Teal and white both mean primary today. Keep the current teal brand and define consistent primary, secondary, quiet and danger variants.

items.title: Unify filters and status badges
items.detail: NFS selected filters, XML counters and Nginx chips use different treatments. Use a consistent selected state and restrained status tokens.

items.title: Give every control an accessible name
items.detail: NFS, backups, DNS, VPN, Docker and Nginx contain unnamed buttons in the accessibility tree; several inputs are named only Input Field. Include the resource name in repeated actions.

items.title: Distinguish pending data from zero
items.detail: Dashboard, Docker, Updates and Nginx initially show zeros or empty content before data arrives. Use unknown placeholders/skeletons until the first response.

items.title: Make secondary text and badges easier to read
items.detail: Several metadata lines and dark chips appear faint. Measure text at 4.5:1 and essential controls at 3:1 before changing tokens; this audit does not certify contrast ratios.

items.title: Add searchable navigation
items.detail: The expanded menu requires long scrolling. Add a small navigation search, preserving the existing resize and collapse behavior.

items.title: Use explicit resource names and consistent terminology
items.detail: Prefer Host over Slave in interface copy, VM disks over VMs Disks, and Kubernetes over K8 Cluster. Keep API identifiers unchanged.

items.title: Check shared modal keyboard behavior
items.detail: Audit dialog semantics, named close controls, Escape, focus containment and focus return. The observed trees expose backgrounds and unnamed close buttons; a full screen-reader test remains needed.

items.title: Standardize dates and technical values
items.detail: Use one date/time format with timezone for schedules, tabular numbers, and monospace for addresses/paths. Preserve exact technical strings and allow copying full values.

items.title: Complete phone, zoom and keyboard checks
items.detail: Check 375px, tablet, landscape, 200% zoom, reduced motion, light theme and keyboard focus before rolling out shared changes. These are validation work, not confirmed defects.

note: Keep the current dark/teal direction, Lucide icons and existing components. No font or dependency replacement is needed.

items.title: Replace redundant storage graphics with one clear comparison
items.detail: The gauge, total bar and volume strip repeat capacity information. Keep a compact total, then show labeled per-volume used/free bars with host and mount names.

items.title: Replace implementation copy with operator copy
items.detail: Replace Uses the same NFS calculation with a plain description of included mounts. Label the Update button Refresh storage so its scope is clear.

items.title: Surface attention items before normal telemetry
items.detail: Add a compact attention summary linking to high storage usage, unhealthy disks and stale hosts, using already available data. Requires agreed thresholds; no new monitoring backend assumed.

name: Host details

items.title: Move tuning controls behind a distinct section
items.detail: Host Controls occupies a large area before disk/network/history diagnostics. Put monitoring first and keep service tuning in an expandable Advanced controls section.

items.title: Make hugepage state understandable
items.detail: Group configured versus active capacity together and explain what zero active capacity means; avoid requiring operators to reconcile Disabled with Active: 2M (0 B). Verify backend meanings first.

items.title: Reduce repeated gauges and tall empty panels
items.detail: Use compact metrics and align host-control content to its actual height. Keep per-core detail available, with a clear expanded state.

note: The warning toast in this screenshot belongs to the development runtime; it is not evidence of a production warning.

items.title: Verify eligibility of devices shown as free disks
items.detail: The list shows /dev/zram0 as a free SSD. Check whether it is actually eligible for array creation; if not, exclude it or explain why it cannot be used. This is not proof that creation accepts it.

items.title: Make capacity and identity easier to scan
items.detail: Add a small labeled usage bar, align used/total/free values, and make UUID secondary but copyable. Preserve the existing balanced density.

items.title: Clarify removal scope
items.detail: Rename Remove to Remove rule and explain that removing the startup rule differs from unmounting the active filesystem. Verify existing behavior before final copy.

items.title: Trim repeated row metadata
items.detail: Keep mount path, array and compression aligned; move repeated host/UUID detail to a disclosure with copy support.

items.title: Explain Caution beside the disk
items.detail: The caution disk shows zero reallocated and pending sectors, so the reason is unclear. Show the actual triggering attribute and a View health details action; do not infer failure from the badge alone.

items.title: Clarify reallocation and action hierarchy
items.detail: Details is repeated as a primary teal action while Reallocation is unexplained. Keep Details neutral and explain potentially intensive maintenance before its confirmation.

items.title: Add health filtering and next-run context
items.detail: Allow attention-only filtering, and show the next scheduled test with timezone. Next-run display may require derived scheduling logic or an API field.

items.title: Offer compact capacity rows
items.detail: Replace or supplement large gauges with name, host, path, used/free and VM connection counts in aligned rows. This is a density choice; retain cards if preferred.

items.title: Separate unmount from routine actions
items.detail: Unmount sits directly beside Connect and Details on every card. Move it to a clearly labeled danger area or menu and explain affected consumers at confirmation.

items.title: Keep full paths inspectable
items.detail: Long export paths wrap inside narrow cards. Provide full-value disclosure and a labeled copy button without expanding every row.

name: ISO library

items.title: Explain unavailable sizes once
items.detail: Every visible size says Not reported. Use an unknown marker with a column-level explanation, or show sizes only when supplied; do not imply zero bytes.

items.title: Add storage and host filters
items.detail: Search already works across the library; optional dropdown filters make storage placement and host availability easier to browse as inventory grows.

note: The current row layout and explicit host availability are good foundations; a full redesign is unnecessary.

items.title: Explain the two RAM measurements
items.detail: Rename RAM and Host RAM (real) only after confirming their semantics, and add short help explaining why they differ. Keep both readings available.

items.title: Make power actions recognizable before clicking
items.detail: The actions have accessible names but no visible labels. Add keyboard-accessible tooltips or short labels for pause, restart, shutdown and details; retain frequently used actions.

items.title: Offer a compact row view for larger fleets
items.detail: Add an optional view with host grouping, state, CPU/RAM/disk, primary IP and actions. Preserve the current cards, colored borders and compact host allocation summaries.

name: VM creation

items.title: Group basic and advanced options
items.detail: Group identity/host, resources, storage and network. Put XML template and specialized flags in Advanced while keeping selected values visible in a review summary.

items.title: Replace API-facing form language
items.detail: Use Host, NFS share and Installation ISO. Remove Sends template_id only when a template is selected and explain the actual effect of selecting a template.

items.title: Associate labels and expose preset buttons correctly
items.detail: Inputs appear as Input Field and RAM/disk presets as containers in the accessibility tree. Give inputs meaningful names and presets button roles with selected state.

items.title: Show host and storage capacity before creation
items.detail: Once host and NFS are selected, show available capacity and explain overcommit warnings. Reuse allocation semantics and avoid silently changing creation rules.

note: Form opened and cancelled without submission. Validation, live creation and failure recovery were not exercised.

items.title: Allow full path and per-interface IP inspection
items.detail: Disk Path is truncated and all IPs share one line. Wrap or disclose the full path with copy, and list addresses individually with interface context when available.

items.title: Give VM details a dedicated URL
items.detail: Make details shareable and preserve browser Back, keeping a lightweight modal for quick inspection if useful. This changes navigation and needs route/state work.

items.title: Clarify what Used measures for raw disks
items.detail: The attached raw disk reads 100%. Verify whether this is host allocation rather than guest filesystem usage and label it accordingly to avoid a false full-disk interpretation.

items.title: Show attachment and path more clearly
items.detail: Give attached VM its own labeled field, disclose/copy the full path, and separate deletion from Grow. Keep attached-resource safety in the existing backend.

items.title: Remove repeated counts and character totals
items.detail: The same one-template count appears in multiple summaries; character counts dominate the page. Keep total/matching count once and show size only in detail.

items.title: Make XML preview readable on demand
items.detail: Use a collapsible formatted code preview instead of a flattened truncated line. Preserve placeholder case exactly and make placeholder behavior available in help.

name: GPUs

items.title: Use a compact host selector toolbar
items.detail: The host selector spans the page while Refresh and counters occupy another row. Match the compact toolbar used by other storage pages.

items.title: Explain the empty inventory state
items.detail: Explain whether no devices were detected versus none eligible for passthrough, and provide Retry and a host-switch suggestion only where the API can distinguish those cases.

note: Only the empty inventory for the selected host was verified; populated GPU assignment is outside this pass.

items.title: Name restore and delete actions by backup
items.detail: Icon-only actions are unnamed in the observed tree. Include VM and backup date in accessible names, and provide tooltips with Restore, Download and Delete.

items.title: Use meaningful storage and backup-state names
items.detail: Replace NFS #1 with its share name where known. Clarify Working / Live versus completed backup status after checking the underlying field semantics.

items.title: Add sorting, filters and collapsible VM groups
items.detail: Keep the approved table layout; add latest-first sorting controls, date/status filters and group collapse for long backup histories.

name: Automatic backups

items.title: Replace average frequency with next-run information
items.detail: 5 d average frequency mixes daily and weekly schedules without helping the operator. Show the next scheduled window per VM and the applicable timezone.

items.title: Keep schedule identity and storage explicit
items.detail: Show weekly day, actual NFS share name, retention and last result. Keep the existing aligned rows and neutral borders.

note: Next-run accuracy depends on scheduler semantics; this needs verification before implementation.

items.title: Prioritize peer connection information
items.detail: Offer search and, if the API provides them, latest handshake and traffic. Move full public keys into a copy/disclosure control so peer identity stays prominent.

items.title: Label copy and remove controls
items.detail: Use Copy public key for [peer] and Remove [peer] labels. Explain what Connect locally does before it starts a local connection workflow.

items.title: Add alias search and sorting
items.detail: Filter by alias, address and VM; keep the row layout and allow copying addresses.

items.title: Make optional metadata lighter
items.detail: Two mostly empty columns consume space. Offer compact default rows with SSH username and VM relationship in details, retaining editable values.

items.title: Explain the connection address choice
items.detail: Show which interface or network each address belongs to when available and explain where the downloaded connection file will be usable.

items.title: Prioritize node state above download setup
items.detail: Put node status first and keep the connection-file action compact. Avoid allocating a full section to an empty disconnected group.

items.title: Separate no resources from healthy resources
items.detail: Healthy beside zero fleets/buckets can be read as a workload verdict. Label service reachability separately and show No fleets / No buckets as inventory state.

items.title: Make the empty state actionable
items.detail: Place Create fleet in the empty-state panel as well as the header, and explain SILO in plain language. Move deleted-fleet recovery to a secondary menu.

name: Single Packet Authorization

items.title: Fix browser autofill and port input semantics
items.detail: The browser filled the Port field with an account email on navigation. Use an explicitly labeled numeric port input and appropriate autocomplete semantics; verify password-manager behavior without submitting a port.

items.title: Make access scope and duration explicit
items.detail: Explain what access is opened, how long it lasts and how it is revoked before Create port. Show actual configured behavior; do not invent an expiry field unsupported by the backend.

note: Screenshot captures initial loading and browser autofill, not a configured-port result. No port was created.

items.title: Show update impact before applying
items.detail: Review the existing confirmation flow for host, package count, automatic reboot and expected interruption. Add missing impact information only after inspecting the current confirmation.

items.title: Use compact package rows
items.detail: Thirty-eight updates each occupy a large card. Use aligned package, installed version, available version and action columns; explain unknown installed versions instead of a bare arrow.

items.title: Make refresh and pending availability explicit
items.detail: Name the refresh control and distinguish checking from no pending packages. Preserve the existing Last checked timestamp and keep automatic interval labels hidden.

items.title: Use semantic controls for filtering and reloading
items.detail: Reload, Select sources and Register Notifications appear as text/containers in the observed tree. Make them keyboard-operable buttons/selects with proper names and state.

items.title: Simplify the filter model
items.detail: Level (API) overlaps INFO/DEBUG switches and accepts arbitrary text. Offer one understandable severity model, with advanced source/limit controls in a disclosure.

items.title: Give empty results a recovery path
items.detail: Differentiate loading, no matching logs, no collected logs and failed query. Offer Clear filters or Retry as applicable and put notification setup in secondary actions.

name: HH Support

items.title: Prevent widgets shrinking below usable sizes
items.detail: The saved layout shows a very narrow text widget and a narrow CPU chart surrounded by gaps. Enforce minimum usable widget dimensions and provide a deliberate Fit layout action without silently overwriting saved positions.

items.title: Explain Live, Offline and Healthy separately
items.detail: The screen shows all three at once. Label connection to telemetry service, App heartbeat and last evaluated health as distinct signals with timestamps.

items.title: Offer alignment and layout recovery tools
items.detail: Add Snap to grid / Align / Reset layout in edit mode, preserving the free placement model. Any reset must preview its effect and preserve a recovery path.

items.title: Make empty widgets concise and useful
items.detail: The narrow waiting widget wraps a long paragraph word by word. Use a short no-data message with expected stream name and a details disclosure.

note: The displayed layout is user-configurable; sparse placement may be intentional. Proposals must preserve existing layouts unless explicitly reset.

items.title: Present intentional 404 behavior without alarm styling
items.detail: Every correctly configured rule shows a red warning-style 404 Not Found. Use a neutral Returns 404 behavior label; reserve red for actual failures.

items.title: Use compact domain rules
items.detail: Offer rows with domain, TLS policy, enabled state and actions. Remove repeated ACTIVE / SSL ENABLED chips when the same information is already expressed.

items.title: Make expiry actionable
items.detail: Show Expires in [days] beside an unambiguous date, with expiry sorting and due-soon filtering. Reuse existing certificate data.

items.title: Match certificate actions to provider capabilities
items.detail: The custom certificate also shows Renew. Verify what that action does and use Replace or Renew according to the actual supported operation.

name: Access lists

items.title: Explain the two kinds of access rules in the empty state
items.detail: Offer concise guidance on HTTP authentication versus client allow/deny rules, then one Create access list action.

items.title: Show policy effects in create/edit review
items.detail: Before save, summarize allow/deny ordering, authentication combination and affected proxies. No populated list or save flow was tested in this audit.

note: Only the empty inventory was inspected; the second item is a proposed verification task, not a confirmed bug.

items.title: Separate setup from everyday proxy management
items.detail: Setup FrontEnd Page competes with Add Proxy Host in the same toolbar. Put setup status in a compact distinct notice, preserving its existing operation.

items.title: Offer searchable compact proxy rows
items.detail: Add free-text search alongside domain grouping, and align domain, destination, TLS and enabled state. Keep operational actions available.

items.title: Reduce the visual dominance of delete
items.detail: Bright filled red Delete appears on every proxy. Use a quiet danger affordance or labeled menu and retain resource-specific confirmation.

items.title: Offer purpose-specific empty-state actions
items.detail: Give Create HTTP pool and Create TCP/UDP pool choices with a brief consumer explanation, instead of requiring an extra type decision after Add pool.

items.title: Show usage and capability restrictions on populated pools
items.detail: Review whether pools show consumers and supported backend capabilities before editing/removal. Empty inventory prevents visual verification of that state.

items.title: Make redirect behavior readable
items.detail: The 302 TEMPORARY and PRESERVE PATH chips are faint. Show clear normal-text labels for code, path behavior and destination.

items.title: Show source-to-destination mapping directly
items.detail: Use Domain → destination, with copy/open controls and an explicit protocol. Preserve configured destinations exactly.

items.title: Align listener and destination fields
items.detail: Use rows with listener port, target host/port, TCP/UDP, TLS and enabled state. Keep description visible and technical values copyable.

items.title: Use protocol-appropriate security copy
items.detail: For a TCP stream, No SSL is informational. Show TLS off neutrally; explain exposure in details instead of implying all non-HTTP streams require HTTPS.

items.title: Contain overflowing image metadata
items.detail: Long label chips run beyond the content area. Show label count and expand to a wrapping key/value table with full-value copy; preserve case and exact strings.

items.title: Add image search and usage context
items.detail: Filter by repository/tag and show in-use references when available. Separate tag and digest so long hashes do not dominate identity; do not offer unverified cleanup savings.

items.title: Separate routine controls from forceful actions
items.detail: Every container exposes Logs, Update, Restart, Pause, Stop, Kill and Remove together. Keep common actions visible and move Kill/Remove to a labeled danger menu with impact confirmation.

items.title: Make container rows scannable
items.detail: Show name, image, textual state/health and ports first; collapse mount lists and restart metadata into details. Add search and state filters.

items.title: Disambiguate displayed capacity
items.detail: Multiple different volumes show the same 33.9 GB / 220.6 GB pair. Verify whether this is backing-filesystem usage, then label it accordingly instead of implying per-volume size.

items.title: Prioritize volume identity and consumers
items.detail: Shorten anonymous hashes visually with full copy/disclosure and show attached containers when available. Distinguish an unused volume only when reference data supports it.

items.title: Collapse verbose network driver options
items.detail: Keep network, driver, subnet and scope prominent. Expand full options as a key/value table without uppercasing technical values.

items.title: Explain built-in and in-use deletion restrictions
items.detail: Built-in bridge/host/none networks display remove controls. Verify server restrictions and disable or explain unavailable actions, retaining backend validation.

items.title: Give the empty state a clear next step
items.detail: Replace plain No repositories configured with a compact explanation and Clone stack action, including accepted repository/compose expectations.

items.title: Review deployment state presentation
items.detail: For populated stacks, check branch/ref, last result, update progress and error recovery. The current host has no repositories, so no such defect is claimed.

items.title: Use consistent interface language
items.detail: Rename Ver to View. Preserve user-authored Portuguese note titles and content exactly.

items.title: Make note previews more useful
items.detail: Render a readable markdown excerpt rather than raw markdown markers, reduce forced empty card height, and provide search as notes grow.

name: Settings

items.title: Name the close icon and theme options clearly
items.detail: The top close button has no accessible name and radio descriptions are light/dark/system. Use Close settings and the visible human-readable option labels.

items.title: Make the settings dialog proportional to its content
items.detail: The dialog contains only theme preferences but uses a large shell. Use a compact layout while retaining readable descriptions and the explicit Close action.

note: No theme preference was changed. Light appearance was not validated.
